question: Which brands are growing fastest year on year?
sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()),
               oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_this_year,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) - 1,
               oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_last_year
FROM s_order_items AS oi
JOIN s_orders   AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN s_products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND p.brand IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.brand
HAVING revenue_last_year > 1000
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_this_year, revenue_last_year) DESC
LIMIT 20
report: Growth as a ratio with both years shown, and a floor on the prior year so a brand going from $5 to $50 does not read as 900% growth. Conditional sums in one pass rather than a self-join.
